verdict.rationale: A high-yield savings sub-account with automated transfer rules is a fair question for a business account product, so the axis applies. The evidence pack does not document any interest-bearing or yield sub-account, savings pockets, or rule-based automatic sweeps. The only nearby items are adjacent features that earn no credit: multi-currency balances (wise-docs-25) and opt-in passthrough FDIC insurance (wise-docs-11), neither of which provides yield or automated transfers.
